answer: Pair every identity with a random stranger each epoch to audit its last 10 deliveries, like weeding a shared garden: each auditor stakes a 10-unit copper bond on its verdict and loses it for a wrong call, while a fake that fails two audits loses its standing. A Sybil cluster cannot audit itself, since random pairing sends 99 of 100 fake audits to honest outsiders. Timber-solid proof comes from the audit trail: every verdict is signed and public, so 100 fakes must fake 1,000 real deliveries and risk 1,000 units in bonds.
